QuestInfo.name: A Tale of Monsters
QuestInfo.0: This is a story of monsters and fear, of choices and consequences. Will your actions bring calm or sorrow to the weary? Can you do what is necessary to protect the defenseless? \r\nFind out, in Masque's third story!
